what: A 4-op FM and subtractive hybrid synth built around a chance arpeggiator: hold a chord, set CHANCE, and it plays melodies. Plus a 32-step sequencer, 50 sounds + RANDOM, chords with strum, swing and humanize, chorus, delay and a shimmer reverb, 16 presets of your own, and MIDI and clock in and out.
author: Nick Culbertson
